DESIGN, AT YOUR DESK

Your own design studio.

A full design studio inside the coding agent you already use. One command, free, nothing leaves your machine but the model calls you already make.

Install the plugin

Open source, MIT. No account, no sign-up.Read the code

/plugin install desk --marketplace adityareddy-dev/deskstudio

THE PROCESS

How a job runs.

You type one line. The Design Manager staffs the job, three roughs come back, the Art Director picks one, a cheaper model polishes, proof checks the pixels, and the Creative Director signs it off or sends it back with notes.

  1. 01

    Roughs

    Three directions from the brief and the brand.

  2. 02

    Pick

    The Art Director looks at the renders, picks one and writes the notes.

  3. 03

    Polish

    The builder desk revises with the notes and the screenshot.

  4. 04

    Proof

    Contrast on the rendered pixels, overflow, safe zones, palette, type scale, copy present.

  5. 05

    Sign-off

    Pass is every axis at 8 or above and the average at 8.5 or above.

Roughs

The UI Designer makes three directions at the senior model from the brief, the brand and the standard for the piece.

rough 1
rough 2
rough 3

Pick

The Art Director looks at the renders, picks one and writes the notes.

Rough 2: headline reads first at both sizes, only amber is the small lamp, fixes are type sizes not layout

Polish

The builder desk revises with the notes and the screenshot. Rounds are cheap, so this is where the iteration goes.

Round 1: 8.4. Round 2: 8.5. Round 3: 8.9.

Proof

Contrast on the rendered pixels, overflow, safe zones, palette, type scale, copy present. No model in the loop. A failure goes back to the builder with the screenshot. It runs on every polished file.

Sign-off

The Creative Director scores eight axes. Pass is every axis at 8 or above and the average at 8.5 or above.

Average 8.9, 3 of 8 rounds.

The Design Manager runs in your session on whatever model you run, and the other 41 desks run as subagents.

You run it from the dashboard.

A local page, nothing leaves your machine. Every control is a write to a file the Manager reads before its next step.

  • Pause at the next step, continue, stop.
  • Move a tier or one desk to another model, for this job or as the default.
  • Write a desk a note. It goes into its next prompt.
  • Pick a rough yourself, over the Art Director.
  • Approve a sign-off under the bar, or send it back with notes.
pick-it-yourself

One real job, run from the dashboard: paused after the roughs, the pick made by hand, the builder role moved from Haiku to Sonnet, and a note written to the UI Designer. It came back signed off at 8.5 in 2 rounds, $2.39 at list price.

Proof checks and the cost record
proof

Proof on real pixels.

Every polished file is rendered in Chrome at each size and checked on the pixels before the Creative Director scores it.

  • Text contrast against the pixels behind it
  • Overflow and clipping
  • Safe zones per platform
  • Colours inside the brand palette
  • Type on the brand scale
  • Every line of copy present
  • Carousels consistent across slides
  • Reading time and flashes in motion

From the quill card job: proof failed twice before passing. Round 1 failed on the type scale, a 248px headline off the brand scale, capped at 232px. Round 3 failed because the X card's headline sat inside the left safe zone, and round 4 fixed it. Signed off at 8.9.

cost-meter

Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Windsurf, OpenCodenpx deskstudio add writes a rules block the agent reads and copies the desk briefs. Models per role.

The runner reaches each provider through the CLI you already have signed in, on the plan you already pay for. API keys are the fallback. One provider is fine, and tiers can mix. Jobs have completed through the Anthropic, OpenAI and Google CLIs. Google uses Antigravity CLI.

OPEN SOURCE

Make your first contribution.

There are setup guides to write for Cursor and Copilot, and proof tests to add for safe-zone boundaries and required copy. None of them need a model call.

Pick a starter issue Your first contribution

Check that an issue is open and unclaimed before starting. A failed install is useful too, report it with the host, version and exact command. Remove private project content from logs.

GET STARTED

Install.

Claude Code, one line.

/plugin install desk --marketplace adityareddy-dev/deskstudio

On a Claude Code older than 2.1.275: /plugin marketplace add adityareddy-dev/deskstudio, then /plugin install desk@deskstudio.

Then ask for something.

/desk:design a launch card for LinkedIn

Other agents, one line in the project.

Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Windsurf or OpenCode: one line in the project.

npx deskstudio add

It writes .desk/, copies the desks to .agents/skills/desk/ and puts one marked block in the agent's instruction file. Every agent by default, one with --agent codex. Run it again any time, it only touches what sits between its markers.

AgentWhere the block goes
CodexAGENTS.md
OpenCodeAGENTS.md
Gemini CLIGEMINI.md
Copilot.github/copilot-instructions.md
Cursor.cursor/rules/desk.mdc
Windsurf.windsurf/rules/desk.md

Then ask the agent in plain words, it reads the block and runs the studio.

design a launch card for LinkedIn

Or run it yourself: npx --package deskstudio desk-run design "a launch card for LinkedIn". The desks call models through the CLI you are already signed in to (claude, codex or agy) or a key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY). npx --package deskstudio desk-run doctor shows which path it will take without making a model call. Files land in .desk/out/<job>/ either way.

GOOD QUESTIONS

FAQ.

Do I need another account?

Open source, MIT. No account, no sign-up.

What leaves my machine?

Only the model calls the desks make and a few research lookups leave it.

What does the score mean?

Scores come from the studio's model reviewers, they are not independent benchmarks.

Can I choose the rough?

Pick a rough yourself, over the Art Director.
